rationale: Codex is out of credits until June 12, and we haven't verified the $10/day cap is actually enforced at the dashboard level. If OpenRouter hits the cap mid-sprint and kills all agents, nothing else matters. WolfWatch can be fixed via event-bus fallback. SSH auth needs GitHub PAT (P1, not P0). Dashboard is nice-to-have. Cap enforcement is the only option that prevents a total compound blackout.
